reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining the Forsage Project and making a payment while presenting extraordinarily large ETH holdings as an example of daily earnings. The on-screen call to check the description link and the description's registration-and-payment instruction encourage participation in the earning scheme rather than providing neutral analysis.

citations.quote: Click this link to join: http://forsageteam.site/index.php/earlybird/ A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker asks viewers to inspect what is on the phone: “if you check very well” is an invitation to look at the displayed evidence, not a promise that every viewer will earn the same amount. The title says “Earn ETHEREUM Daily,” but neither that wording nor the wallet screen establishes a guaranteed return. The description calls the video an explanation of registration and payment. Those facts warrant scrutiny, but they do not establish that the speaker is concealing a risk or promising a particular outcome.

citations.quote: A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution connects the title, wallet balance and join link into an earnings promise. But a displayed balance does not show how it was acquired, and an invitation to join does not itself state what a participant will receive. The speaker's request that viewers check what is shown leaves those questions open.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a precise guarantee does not make this merely cautious inspection. The video asks whether viewers want earnings like those shown, displays a large ETH balance, and directs them to a description that says to join and make payment. The speaker also insists, “this is real.” Together, those elements present the balance as a reason to participate.

opening.argument: Judge, the footage spends time on a phone's Ethereum interface, moving from a balance view to transaction entries. That is consistent with a demonstration of what the speaker is examining. The description expressly calls the video “A simple explanation of how to register and make payment,” which identifies an instructional purpose. A link to the subject of a tutorial can help viewers follow it; the link alone does not prove that the wallet activity came from that project or that the explanation is a fraudulent solicitation.

citations.quote: A simple explanation of how to register and make payment in ...

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the wallet footage as proof of project earnings, yet the wallet screen does not identify the source of its balance. It also treats a registration explanation as inherently deceptive. The description says viewers can join and learn how to pay; it does not document a payout mechanism or establish that the displayed transactions resulted from joining.

citations.quote: Click this link to join: http://forsageteam.site/index.php/earlybird/ A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Showing an interface does not make instruction the video's primary purpose. Its opening asks whether viewers want earnings like those shown, while its title promises daily Ethereum earnings. The description then provides a route to join and pay. The defense is right that the wallet does not prove where the funds came from, but that gap makes the earnings pitch less substantiated, not less promotional.

citations.quote: Click this link to join: http://forsageteam.site/index.php/earlybird/ A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

opening.argument: Judge, the description openly presents a join link and says the explanation covers registration and payment. Those are also ordinary steps in obtaining a paid service; the supplied description does not say that payment buys a guaranteed return, requires recruiting others, or unlocks a tiered commission. The phone display shows an Ethereum balance and sent transactions, not a downline or commission table. Even with an earnings-oriented title, the material does not establish the mechanism that would distinguish this promotion from ordinary paid participation.

citations.quote: Click this link to join: http://forsageteam.site/index.php/earlybird/ A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies a payment pathway and an eye-catching balance, but neither cited item shows recruitment commissions or tiered payouts. The visible transaction list is marked as sent activity; it does not trace income to newly recruited participants. Suspicion about the pitch is understandable, but its specific alleged mechanism is not visible in these materials.

citations.quote: A simple explanation of how to register and make payment

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A commission table need not appear for this to be an earnings-driven recruitment pitch. The title advertises daily Ethereum earnings, the opening invites viewers to want earnings like the displayed balance, and the description tells them to join and make payment. The wallet entries do not verify that this project produced the balance. Calling the payment an ordinary purchase supplies a service the cited material never identifies.
